narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to provide dermatological health advice for winter skincare while simultaneously promoting the services and brand of 'DRX Dermatology Clinic'. By identifying three common but harmful winter habits—direct heat from heaters, excessively hot showers, and soap overuse—the narrator establishes herself as an authority and invites viewers to contact the clinic for professional care.
